cases.rationale: An actual toilet with raised seat and cistern fills the right side; the left basin and attached tap identify a sink. The photographer's shoe-covered feet at the bottom identify a visible person. The wall fixture is a toilet-paper holder, and the dark floor vessel is a waste bin, not a bowl or drinking cup. I considered each of the 75 definitions against the entire crop; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

Two people in the foreground and additional distant human figures are visible on grass. A colorful airborne fabric kite with a tail is identifiable against the sky. Tiny dark winglike marks high in the sky could be distant birds, but their few pixels do not resolve bird identity, so bird is unclear. The trees are unpotted and neither their foliage nor the kite depicts an actual additional category object. Every frozen definition was considered.

The visible human hand, arm and torso establish person. A large cheesecake with a removed portion and a separate plated slice identify cake; the orange surface supporting these eating plates is a dining table. The person holds a metal eating utensil carrying cake, but the food obscures its working end enough that fork versus spoon is unresolved; both remain unclear. The flat plates are not bowls, and there is no identifiable knife. I explicitly considered all 75 definitions.

A man is clearly visible next to an open laptop. Its screen connects to the hinge and silver base, establishing an integrated laptop rather than a standalone TV/monitor. The crop ends at the hinge/base without identifiable keyboard keys, so keyboard is no. The bright green shapes behind it lack plant-and-pot evidence, and no necktie is visible. All 75 definitions were individually considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

Several people stand on the grass, including the prominent child in pink. The person at left holds a colorful structured kite with long hanging streamers. A dark rounded mass on that person's back could be a backpack but its pack structure and straps are not sufficiently resolved, so backpack is unclear. Striped fabric near the center is not identifiable as a handbag or suitcase. The visible trees are unpotted. I considered every one of the 75 definitions.

A close view shows the backs and projecting hoods of mounted traffic-signal heads, which identify an actual traffic light despite the lamps facing away. The PULTENEY street-name board is not a stop sign. The blue pole, sky and building fragments do not identify any of the other category objects. I considered all 75 frozen definitions; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

A seated woman holds an open hinged mobile handset in her hand; its flip-phone body and screen/handset layout identify a cell phone rather than a remote. She sits directly on rock beside water, with rock overhead and unpotted vegetation reflected in the water. There is no visible chair, bench, boat or category animal. All 75 definitions were explicitly considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

A brown plush teddy with stuffed limbs and a ribbon is visible, not an actual bear. A handled decorative mug on an orange saucer and a transparent drinking cup identify cup. The leafy succulent at the left has a visible pot, and the tall flower-holding vessel behind the cup identifies a vase. The ribbon is not an identifiable necktie. A dark narrow implement rises from the clear cup but its lower end is hidden, leaving spoon identity unclear. The cloth-covered support could be an eating table or a decorative display surface, so dining table remains unclear. The small seated figure is a statue, not a person; the framed image is not a book. Every definition was considered.

A floatplane with identifiable fuselage, wings, tail and floats occupies the foreground water, and the large passenger ship with hull and decks is an actual boat. The airplane is not itself counted as a boat. Tiny upright shapes along the ship's upper deck could be people but cannot be separated confidently from deck structures at this resolution, so person is unclear. Background buildings and unpotted trees do not establish other category objects. I considered all 75 definitions.

The large red bicycle signal and the smaller lit red signal farther back identify actual traffic-light assemblies. The bicycle symbol is a depiction within a signal, not an actual bicycle. A low blurred white-and-dark moving object at the left plausibly is a passenger car, but motion blur and the crop edge obscure an identifiable body, so car remains unclear. The triangular yield sign is not a stop sign, and the other poles and street lamps are not additional category objects. All 75 definitions were considered.

An actual three-lamp traffic-signal head hangs from a yellow support with its red lamp illuminated. The remaining crop contains sky, clouds and overhead utility wires and fittings. Those wires are not a kite/string assembly or identifiable vehicle parts. I explicitly considered every one of the 75 definitions; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

A baseball batter in a numbered uniform and helmet is plainly visible, with another human arm at the far left. His long dark bat is not one of the 75 target categories. The pale gloves on his hands are batting gloves and are expressly excluded from baseball glove; no fielding mitt is visible. The netting, dirt and grass contain no other identifiable category objects. Every frozen definition was considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.
